labeling_instructions: Ground-truth unit is the audio file, not the incident row.
verified.transcript: listen and type the spoken words fresh. Do NOT paste the system transcript or WER is always zero.
verified.expected_dispatch_count: number of distinct real dispatches in the audio (ignore preambles).
verified.dispatches: one object per dispatch, in spoken order. Seeds are hints from system output.
Fields use canonical/normalized form (e.g. '7602 W Meadowbrook Ave'); spoken form lives only in transcript.
Drop dispatch-center preambles like '1430 hours Phoenix Fire Regional Dispatch'.
